acceptance.text: `TestAkOpenHomeOutsideProject`: with app-url `http://127.0.0.1:8484/` and the launch-code file as wbOpenHome writes them, `grid open` with no operand run from a folder outside every project exits 0 and hands the browser exactly `http://127.0.0.1:8484/api/launch?code=<wbOpenCode>#/`; without the code file it hands `http://127.0.0.1:8484/#/` and stderr holds "grid open: no launch code was found; the page opens without one." (open.go:175). Red on base: exit non-zero with "give a task id or folder, or run inside a task folder" (task_operand.go:47); paste that line.

`TestAkOpenHomeInProjectFolder` and `TestAkOpenHomeJSON`: run from the project folder of openFixture with no task folder as cwd, `grid open --json` prints exactly one field `url` ending in `/#/`; with no app-url and no GRID_APP_URL it prints `{"url":"#/"}` and stderr holds "grid open: the app's address is not known. Start the app, then run grid open again." (open.go:166). Red on base: as row 1.

`TestAkOpenTaskStillOpensTask`: from inside the task folder of openFixtureAt, `grid open` with no operand still hands the browser the task route `#/t/<project>/<id>/overview` (open.go:148), and `grid open T-99` still exits non-zero with no address opened.
`go test -count=1 -v ./internal/cli/ -run 'TestAkOpen|TestOpen|TestWbOpen|TestWaOpen|TestGuestProjectParity'` exits 0 with a `--- PASS:` line for each TestAkOpen test and no `--- FAIL`.
